title: Consumer Shopping Enhancement App: Project Charter
description:
This is a project charter undertaken by Farmer's Way to 
                        develop a web app to enhance the shopping experience of 
                        their consumers.

title: Consumer Shopping Enhancement App: Project Scope
description:
This is the project scope document that details what was
                        planned to be done for the Consumer Shopping Enhancement
                        Application project.

title: Consumer Shopping Enhancement App: Executive Presentation
description:
This is a final presentation for the Consumer Shopping 
                        Enhancement App that details its value in relation to 
                        the strategic goals of Farmer's Way.

title: Tableau Presentation
description: This is a presentation on Data Visualization and Tableau.

title: Office Designs Presentation
description:
This is a presentation on various office designs employed
                        in business that seek to enhance communication.

title: Analytical Report on Firefighter Logistics
description:
This is an analytical report detailing how technology can 
                        assist in the food logistics of a newly established fire 
                        station.

title: Inventory Management Redesign
description:
This is an infographic detailing an inventory management 
                        redesign for Mercantil Excelsior, an international cheese 
                        distrbutor.

title: Customer Review Sentiment Analysis
description:
This project explores sentiment classification of product reviews 
                        using a combination of TF-IDF and Word2Vec embeddings integrated 
                        into a soft-voting ensemble of Logistic Regression and XGBoost models.

title: Predictive Maintenance Model
description:
A supervised learning pipeline designed to predict equipment 
                        failure using real-time sensor data, implementing feature scaling, 
                        cross-validation, and XGBoost tuning for improved precision.

title: Computer Vision Quality Control System
description:
An AI-based defect detection system trained on product images 
                        to automatically flag visual inconsistencies in manufacturing lines, 
                        using CNN architectures fine-tuned from ResNet50.

title: Data Visualization Dashboard with Tableau
description:
A dynamic Tableau dashboard created to visualize KPIs, price 
                        distributions, and consumer behavior trends across multiple retail 
                        datasets, providing executive-level insights at a glance.

title: Chatbot for Insurance Lead Qualification
description:
A conversational AI agent built to automate lead intake for an 
                        insurance services platform, leveraging GPT APIs for dynamic response 
                        generation and sentiment-based intent routing.

title: Bikewatching – Bluebikes Traffic Map
description: Interactive geospatial visualization of Boston–Cambridge Bluebikes traffic using Mapbox GL JS and D3, with bike lanes, station markers sized by traffic, and a time slider plus legend for arrivals vs. departures.
